import random
class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, x):
        self.val = x
        self.left = None
        self.right = None
        
def generate_binary_tree(n):
    if n == 0:
        return None

    root = TreeNode(random.randint(-1000, 1000))

    num_left = random.randint(0, n-1)
    num_right = n - 1 - num_left

    root.left = generate_binary_tree(num_left)
    root.right = generate_binary_tree(num_right)

    return root

def generate_test_case():
    root = generate_binary_tree(random.randint(1, 100))
    
    target = random.randint(-1000, 1000)
            
    import lctk
    root = lctk.binaryTree2Arr(root)
    return root, target
